speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Eat. The morning has had enough of your pen, and the house dines when I say it dines.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am eating. The page can wait upstairs.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The fair is cried for tomorrow, sir. Mistress says fairings are not a dinner.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Tomorrow is Smithfield, if you must go. Today is this table. I am not sending a penny out of the house for a gingerbread you have not yet seen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tomorrow is the fair. Monday is the door. I am not playing today, and I am not buying today.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then sit, and do not make the loaf into a speech. You had your look at it yesterday. I will not have it measured twice so a man can feel busy.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not measuring it. I am eating it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The cat is still on the book, sir. I did not move him to make room for a plate.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him. The book is not today's work either.
